text:
Same street, two ramen legends: one opened as a street stall in 1938, the other in 1947. They sit side by side, five minutes from Kyoto Station.

Daiichi Asahi opens at 6:00 and serves until 1:00 at night. Shinpuku Saikan closes on some Wednesdays, Daiichi Asahi on Thursdays, so one of them is usually open.

Have you queued for either of them?
